QuestInfo.name: [LINE FRIENDS] Completing the Special Collection
QuestInfo.0: CONY looks like she has something more to say. Go talk to her.
QuestInfo.1: Help CONY fill out her entire #bMaple World Special Collection#k and she'll give you a special title filled with heart, friendship, and all that good stuff.
QuestInfo.2: You helped CONY collect every souvenir for her #bMaple World Special Collection#k. In thanks for your constant assistance, she gave you a special title to remind you of all the memories you both made.
